name: סִינִי
summary: The Sinites, a clan among Canaan’s descendants; the definite singular names the clan as a whole. Its verbal etymology is unknown.

evidence.note: הַסִּינִי follows the Hivite and the Arkite in a list identified as the clans of the Canaanites.
The parallel genealogy lists the Sinite after the Hivite and the Arkite.

note: Moved from the former word entry `siyniy`. סינ was the consonantal base of the gentilic. Its verbal etymology is unknown.
